#ad Buying a power bank for your laptop? Ignore the mAh. Check the watts. Most thin laptops need 45–65W over USB-C PD. Full guide: link in bio.
#powerbank #techtips #laptop #gadgetsuk

#ad Flying soon? Power banks go in hand luggage only, and airlines usually cap them at 100Wh without approval. A 20,000mAh bank is about 74Wh, so you're fine. Full guide: link in bio.
#traveltips #powerbank #travelhacks #uktravel

#ad Three power banks for three jobs. Phone: slim 10,000mAh with 20W. Laptop: 20,000mAh with 65W. iPhone: Qi2 magnetic. Picks in our guide, link in bio.
#powerbank #iphone #techuk #gadgets

#ad Want to know what your tumble dryer actually costs to run? An energy-monitoring smart plug shows the kWh. Multiply by your unit rate on your energy bill. Done. Link in bio.
#energybills #costofliving #smarthome #moneysavinguk

#ad Before you buy a smart plug for a heater or kettle, check it's rated for a full 13A. Our checklist is in the guide, link in bio.
#smartplug #smarthomeuk #homehacks

#ad Mixed household of Alexa, Google and iPhones? Matter-certified smart plugs work with all three. Guide in bio.
#alexa #googlehome #applehome #smarthome

#ad Working off a laptop on the sofa? Raise the screen to eye level with a laptop stand and add any external keyboard. Your neck will notice by Friday. Link in bio.
#wfh #desksetup #homeoffice #studentlife

#ad One USB-C cable for monitor, charging and USB. Get a hub with HDMI and 100W pass-through. Check it supports your monitor's resolution first. Link in bio.
#desksetup #usbc #homeoffice #techtips

#ad A better desk for under £100: laptop stand, USB-C hub, dimmable LED lamp, cable tray. Full list in bio.
#desksetup #wfhsetup #studentdesk #homeofficeuk

#ad The energy price cap rose 4% this month. One cheap fix: heat yourself, not the whole house. Which? estimates a heated throw costs about 2p–3p an hour to run, against 8p–76p for an electric heater. Look for an auto-off timer and a washable cover.
#heatedthrow #energybills #winterwarmth #costofliving
Full guide: link in bio.

#ad Buying a dehumidifier? The number that matters is litres per day extracted, not tank size. 7–12L suits a small flat with mild damp, 14–16L a bigger household, 18L+ if you dry clothes indoors. Add a humidistat so it isn't running for nothing.
#dehumidifier #condensation #dampandmould #rentersuk
Full guide: link in bio.

#ad Quick maths for any appliance this winter: watts ÷ 1000 × hours × your unit rate. Under the October–December 2026 price cap that rate is about 26.32p per kWh, so a 100W heated throw costs about 2.6p an hour. Check the rate on your own bill.
#energybills #moneysavinguk #costofliving #energysaving
Full guide: link in bio.

#ad Smart radiator valves let you heat the rooms you use and turn the spare room down. Before buying: they swap onto existing thermostatic valves (TRVs), most need the same brand's bridge, and savings are smaller in small homes. Which? puts single valves at about £35–£80.
#smarthome #smartheating #radiator #energybills
Full guide: link in bio.

#ad Getting the electric blanket out of the cupboard? Check it before you use it. Replace it if the fabric is worn or you can see wires. Unplug it before you sleep unless it has a thermostat designed for safe overnight use. A timer helps too.
#electricblanket #homesafety #winterwarmth #ukhome
Full guide: link in bio.

#ad Most UK dehumidifiers are compressor models, and they struggle in cold spaces. For an unheated garage, conservatory or outbuilding, Which? suggests a desiccant model instead. Heated bedrooms and flats? Compressor is fine and usually cheaper to run.
#dehumidifier #dampandmould #garage #winterprep
Full guide: link in bio.

#ad Our new winter guide: three ways to stay warm and dry for less. Heated throws and underblankets, dehumidifiers sized for your home, and smart radiator valves for the rooms you actually use. Running costs explained in plain English.
#winterwarmth #energybills #heatedthrow #dehumidifier
Full guide: link in bio.

#ad New guide: useful tech gifts under £100, plus how to check a Black Friday deal is real.
Chargers, item trackers and noise-cancelling headphones, with the one thing to check on each. We haven't tested these ourselves, so figures are credited to their source.
#techgifts #christmasgifts #blackfridayuk #giftideas
Full guide: link in bio.

#ad Black Friday is 27 November, but that deal may not be a one-off.
Which? tracked 175 home, tech and health appliances around the 2024 sales. 83% were the same price or cheaper at least once outside the four-week sale period. Check the last six months of prices before you buy.
#blackfridayuk #dealcheck #techdeals #moneysaving
Full guide: link in bio.

#ad Buying a Bluetooth tracker as a gift? Check their phone first.
An AirTag sets up on an iPhone or iPad, so it's the wrong gift for an Android owner. Find Hub tags are the Android route, and Google lists its Pixel Tag as coming this month.
#bluetoothtracker #airtag #pixeltag #techgifts
Full guide: link in bio.

#ad Three tech gifts under £100 for three kinds of people.
Always out of charge: a 100W USB-C charger with several ports. Always losing keys: a Bluetooth tracker that matches their phone. Noisy flat or housemates: noise-cancelling headphones.
#techgifts #christmasgifts #studentlife #wfhsetup
Full guide: link in bio.

#ad Item trackers: a 4-pack saves £17 against four singles.
Expert Reviews lists the 2nd-gen AirTag at £29, or £99 for four, which is £24.75 a tag. Tech Advisor reports the same UK prices for Google's Pixel Tag. AirTags don't come with a keyring, so add a few pounds for one.
#airtag #pixeltag #bluetoothtracker #christmasgifts
Full guide: link in bio.

#ad That 100W USB-C charger may not give your laptop 100W.
The headline figure is usually shared between the ports. Most thin laptops need 45–65W, so check what one port delivers with everything plugged in, and whether you still need USB-A.
#usbccharger #gancharger #laptopcharger #techgifts
Full guide: link in bio.

#ad Noise-cancelling headphones under £100: over-ear for the desk, earbuds for the commute.
Sony's WH-CH720N has a £99 list price and hit £68 at Amazon in March, says What Hi-Fi?. Which? lists Anker's Liberty 4NC earbuds as typically under £100. Check the returns policy, as Which? warns hygiene rules can limit them.
#noisecancelling #headphones #studentlife #wfhsetup
Full guide: link in bio.
